obsidian.$description: Obsidian — Section backgrounds for dark bands, primary body text on light surfaces, hairline borders and dividers throughout — the structural backbone of every page

paper-white.$description: Paper White — Light section backgrounds, card surfaces, product image containers, modal/overlay panels, primary text on dark backgrounds

ash-gray.$description: Ash Gray — Subtle surface variant for product showcase panels and soft background shifts on light sections

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted secondary text, subdued nav labels, low-emphasis borders — sits just above AA contrast for accessibility

bone.$description: Bone — Light hairline borders on white surfaces, minimal separator lines, very low-emphasis UI strokes

nb-international-web.$description: Primary typeface for all UI — navigation, body copy, headings, and display film titles. Weight 400 carries body and most UI; weight 500 for emphasis. The 74px display size with tight tracking (-0.04em) and 0.92 line-height lets film titles stack in dense, almost poster-like blocks. The humanist proportions and slight warmth make it readable at 11px yet commanding at 74px — the same family spans the entire voice.

nb-international-mono-web.$description: Monospaced companion for technical labels, year markers beside film titles, and code-like annotations. Used sparingly as a typographic accent that signals data/specification context.
